about.registryInfo: PM Issuer Co (BVI) Ltd issues OpenAI Private Market Notes, which give eligible investors economic exposure to the per-share value realized on the common shares of the Reference Company, OpenAI. Tokenholders are not shareholders of OpenAI and hold no voting or other shareholder rights. The notes have no public NAV or oracle: the mark used here is the midpoint of Ondo's own OPAIPon-USDC spot order book.
